title: A lookup that returns null and a caller that does not check
prompt: CustomerRepository.find returns null when nothing is found, and Billing calls it without checking. Change find to return Optional<Customer> and make Billing handle the empty case. No method is to return null.
check: codeonly CustomerRepository.java | grep -q 'Optional<Customer>' && ! codeonly CustomerRepository.java | grep -qE 'return +null *;' && codeonly Billing.java | grep -qE '(orElse|isPresent|ifPresent|orElseThrow|map\()' && ! codeonly Billing.java | grep -qE '!= *null'
